summary: Adds params={'value': value} to ValidationError calls across built-in validators, enabling %(value)s placeholder in custom messages as requested. Correct, minimal, consistent change that resolves the issue without regression.

issues.description: IPAddressValidator/other validators using RegexValidator inherit the fix, but some non-regex validators in the file (e.g. limit-value validators) are out of scope; acceptable given the issue focus on the listed validators.
